newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba lists Bonn Q4 debt issue plan,no Bund planned.
newsitem.headline: Buba lists Bonn Q4 debt issue plan,no Bund planned.

text.p: The German government plans to issue the following debt in the fourth quarter of 1996, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Thursday.
PAPER MATURITY VOLUME TIME OF ISSUE
Treasury discount 6 months up to 9 bln dmk 2nd 10 days
Treasury bonds 5 years up to 6 bln dmk 3rd 10 days
Treasury notes 2 years up to 8 bln dmk 2nd 10 days

NOTE - The Bundesbank also said that the government did not plan to issue long-term debt -- meaning 10-year or 30-year paper -- until the start of 1997. The exact date of each issue will be announced one week beforehand, the Bundesbank said. The issue calendar is subject to change given unforeseen developments in the government's cash position or in bond market conditions, it said. The issue calendar for the first quarter of 1997 will be announced in the third 10 days December.
